resources.name: Free Music Archive (CC0 / CC BY only)

resources.reason: Filter/account terms UNVERIFIED; CC BY needs credit; avoid ND (syncing to video is an adaptation).

resources.license: Creative Commons free option requiring credit (version reported as CC BY 4.0, UNVERIFIED at source) or paid Standard License without credit

resources.name: Mixkit music
resources.license: Mixkit Stock Music Free License or Restricted License per item (full text UNVERIFIED)
resources.reason: Skip Restricted items.

resources.name: Musopen

resources.reason: Some tracks may be registered in Content ID (UNVERIFIED); keep proof of download.

resources.license: Per track CC (mostly CC BY per secondary sources; page 403)

resources.name: Bensound (free tier)
resources.license: Bensound free license (UNVERIFIED: page 404): credit required, limited to free online video; no ads

resources.name: Jamendo Music
resources.license: Per track CC, all BY, most BY-NC; commercial use via paid Jamendo Licensing

resources.name: YouTube Audio Library
resources.license: Standard YouTube Audio Library license (reported YouTube-only) or CC BY 4.0 per track (secondary sources conflict)
